batches.title: mon-motion constant profile (sway/squeeze/ellipse/ages)
batches.recipe: profile is script-argument constants only (bind.ts:3, wrap.ts:7, battleMenu.ts:1395, faintAttack.ts:58); fieldProfile = SceneOnFaintAttackFieldProfile (HP + player status). Bind/Wrap have bilateral staged scenarios; Double Team and Faint Attack have ONE Onix/Grovyle fixture and no staged scenario, so they need a bilateral staging scenario + probe first (a good staging-only unit).
batches.caveat: Double Team / Faint Attack: single orientation, no tools/battle-lab scenario

batches.title: sprite-slot-only plan (new wall-style allocator PLANS entries; no order seed in config)
batches.recipe: add rows to PLANS in src/engine/liveMoveSpriteAllocator.ts (spawn age + lifetime per sprite from the script, like the wall sparkles) and feed ringSlots / spriteSlots / allocationSlots / battler slot (liveSpriteSlotForOwner). Dragon Dance / Sweet Scent slots are optional in the profile. Prereqs: net-zero audit rows (none of the 84 are in LIVE_SPRITE_ALLOCATOR_NET_ZERO_MOVE_IDS) and a tie audit like docs/allocator-consumer-tie-audit.md.
